item.title: Czech Inflation Quickens With Central Bank Set to Hold Rates
item.description: Inflation in the Czech Republic accelerated in July but remained below the central bank’s target, bolstering expectations that interest rates will stay on hold this week.

item.title: Schaeffler Targets 1,300 Job Cuts With Early Pension Push
item.description: Schaeffler AG plans to cut its German workforce through an expanded phased-retirement program as weak automotive demand continues to pressure the supplier.

item.title: Moove Hits $2.1 Billion Valuation in Mubadala-Led Fundraising
item.description: Moove has closed a $250 million investment round led by Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala, which will help the vehicle-financing and fleet-management startup add services for self-driving cars and expand into new geographies.

item.title: Glencore Has Taken a Provision on Radiant World Exposure
item.description: Glencore Plc said it has taken a provision on its exposure to iron ore trader Radiant World but that the exposure was not material to the company.

item.title: Moonshot Backer Monolith Seeks to Raise $500 Million in New Fund
item.description: Monolith Management, which backed artificial intelligence sensation Moonshot, wants to raise $500 million for a new fund focused on Chinese AI, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Honda Raises Outlook 30% as Weak Yen, US Demand Lift Profits
item.description: Honda Motor Co. raised its profit outlook after the motorcycle business, a weak yen and US demand for hybrids lifted quarterly results to a record.

item.title: Vietnam’s Techcombank Seeks $1 Billion, Joining Rush for Funds
item.description: Vietnam Technological and Commercial JSB, known as Techcombank, is seeking a $1 billion loan for regular business operations, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be one of the Southeast Asian nation’s largest debt deals this year.

item.title: Next Lifts Outlook as UK’s Hot Summer Boosts Clothing Sales
item.description: Next Plc raised its outlook for the third time this fiscal year, after sales surged in the second quarter due to warm UK weather and pent-up demand in the Middle East and northern Europe.

item.title: China Sells Long-Dated Offshore Yuan Bonds at Record Low Yields
item.description: China sold long-dated yuan-denominated sovereign bonds in Hong Kong at record-low yields, underscoring strong demand from global investors for the offshore issuance.

item.title: Glencore Profit Jumps on Trading Boom and Record Copper
item.description: Glencore Plc reported a steep jump in profits after a surge in the price of its most important commodities and its trading unit had one of its best ever periods as the Iran war sent energy prices soaring.

item.title: FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Rise as Glencore, Next Rally on Earnings
item.description: FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Rise as Glencore, Next Rally on Earnings【原文：FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Rise as Glencore, Next Rally on Earnings】

item.title: Infineon Falls as AI Boom Concerns Trump Strong Sales Forecast
item.description: Infineon Technologies AG shares fell after a strong revenue forecast in the current quarter failed to convince investors, who are increasingly worried about high valuations in the chip sector.

item.title: Allianz to Buy UOB Asset Management Unit as CEO Targets Asia
item.description: Allianz SE agreed to buy the asset management unit of Singapore’s United Overseas Bank Ltd., marking the German insurer’s second major deal in recent days as Chief Executive Officer Oliver Baete pursues growth in the region.

item.title: Japan’s Cabinet Approves Sales Tax Cut With Funding Unclear
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s cabinet approved a plan to temporarily cut the sales tax on food for two years, in a move aimed at easing pressure on households that is also fueling concerns over Japan’s fiscal health.

item.title: EQT-Run Scaleup Europe Fund Invests in Satellite Startup Iceye
item.description: Europe’s new €5 billion ($5.8 billion) technology fund has disclosed that its first investment is in Finnish satellite company Iceye Oy, part of the bloc’s push to cultivate startups working on strategic technologies.

item.title: SoftBank-Backed OfBusiness Is Said to Explore Reviving India IPO
item.description: OFB Tech Pvt, the operator of technology supply chain and financing platform OfBusiness, is considering reviving plans for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $800 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: RBI Holds Rates as Inflation Outlook Improves, Growth Stays Firm
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India kept its benchmark rate unchanged for a fourth straight meeting, predicting inflation will ease further and growth will remain resilient even as it monitors the impact of higher energy prices from the Iran war.

item.title: Key Options Trade Displays Abnormal Pattern With India Auction
item.description: A key options trade particularly popular in India to bet on volatility on the day equity derivatives expire showed an unusual pattern on Tuesday, highlighting a potential trading opportunity as market players grapple with a new mechanism for determining closing prices.

item.title: Indonesian Growth Beats in Boost for Policymakers; Stocks Gain
item.description: Indonesia’s economy expanded faster than expected in the second quarter, with household spending and investment providing a cushion from a challenging global backdrop. Stocks gained.

item.title: Mitsubishi UBE Cement Is Said to Plan for December Tokyo Listing
item.description: Mitsubishi UBE Cement Corp. is planning to go public as soon as December, according to people familiar with the matter, five years after being formed through units of Japanese materials companies.

item.title: China’s Official Newspaper Warns US Over Expanding Tech Curbs
item.description: The official newspaper of China’s ruling Communist Party warned of countermeasures against widening US technology curbs as Washington considers banning imports of some Chinese AI components, adding a fresh source of strain to the countries’ fragile trade truce.

item.title: Thai Inflation Eases to 1.95% in July, Slows for Third Month
item.description: Thailand’s inflation unexpectedly eased for a third straight month, bolstering the central bank’s view that it can keep interest rates on hold to support the economy.

item.title: Thailand Rules Out Fully Owned SpaceX Venture in US Trade Talks
item.description: Thailand won’t allow US firms to establish fully foreign-owned satellite telecoms as part of trade talks with the Trump administration, resisting such investments in the sector over sovereignty issues, said the country’s vice commerce minister.

item.title: New Zealand’s Plan to Move to Annual Census Hits Political Hurdle
item.description: New Zealand’s statistics agency may need to run the next five-yearly census in 2028 after all as a plan to defer it and revert to annual surveys from 2030 runs into political hurdles.

item.title: China’s AI Agent Unicorn Lovart Is Said to Explore Hong Kong IPO
item.description: Evoken, the Chinese startup behind AI design agent Lovart, is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, people familiar with the matter said, the latest such firm seeking to tap booming investor demand for artificial intelligence tools after the breakout success of Manus.

item.title: SK Hynix Climbs as Investors Bet on Shareholder Return Plan
item.description: Shares of SK Hynix Inc. advanced, lifted by an overnight rally in US chipmakers and speculation that the Korean firm may soon unveil buybacks and other details of a broader shareholder return plan.

item.title: LIC’s Big Share Sale Draws Investors Even as India’s IPO Market Stalls
item.description: India expands the size of the offering to raise $3.3 billion amid strong demand.

item.title: Temasek, Morgan Stanley Are Said to Eye Adtek Pre-IPO Investment
item.description: Shenzhen Adtek Technology Co. is close to raising up to 2 billion yuan ($296 million) in a private fundraising round ahead of its planned initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Manipal Health Set for Muted Mumbai Debut After $960 Million IPO
item.description: Manipal Health Enterprises Ltd. is set for a muted stock market debut in Mumbai after its $960 million initial public offering, as gray market trading signals cooling investor sentiment.

item.title: Chinese Optical Stocks Slide on Report of Proposed US Import Ban
item.description: Zhongji Innolight Co. led losses in Chinese optical stocks after Reuters reported that the US is drafting a ban on imports of some Chinese data center components to protect AI infrastructure.
